Clean, treatment-enabling safety : no clinically meaningful toxicity beyond chemotherapy, comparing favorably with amivantamab plus chemotherapy on a cross-trial basis. Partnering and KOL discussions ongoing during ASCO 2026 : updated data and slides filed today on Form 8-K and are in use for partnering and clinical discussions during ASCO 2026 in Chicago.
